status: calibration: generated; Tripo's free rig check refused a quadruped rig, so it was bound without credits to the game's own horse skeleton and reviewed; not shipped
use: Step 0 calibration (docs/graphics-tripo-plan.md): a pack mule of the baggage train, rigged by Tripo on four legs (rig v2.5, quadruped) and given Tripo's quadruped walk, and also bound without credits to the game's own horse skeleton (scripts/assets/bind-horse.py), so the two ways of animating release G4's animals can be compared in the game.

generator.prompt: A Roman army pack mule of the mid-3rd century AD standing square for rigging: all four legs straight and vertical, evenly spaced, head raised and facing forward, long ears upright, tail hanging straight down, symmetrical. A sturdy mule about 1.35 metres at the withers with a dark bay-brown coat, a pale muzzle and belly and a short upright mane, a plain leather headstall with its lead rope coiled on the saddle, and a wooden pack saddle on a woollen pad carrying two evenly lashed bundles of baggage, one on each side. Realistic proportions, anatomically accurate. No rider, no cart, no shafts, no text or inscriptions, no modern objects, no fantasy elements.
